anomalies.observed: On sheet 1 (root), 'Water Height Sensor', the TF-Luna LiDAR PR1 is fully wired through header H1/P1: VCC to the +5V rail, GND to ground, and its SDA/SCL pins carry the global labels I2C_SDA and I2C_SCL, joining the main non-isolated I2C bus that also carries M1A IO4/IO5 and R3/R4 pull-ups.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that PR1 is 'marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net' and that 'all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free' — the intended r2 design deliberately leaves the LiDAR unconnected (water level is handled by the float switches/ultrasonic path).

anomalies.impact: This build adds an I2C device (TF-Luna at address 0x10) and a 5V load onto the main I2C bus that the intended design does not have. Firmware never initializes it, so if populated it would appear as an unknown bus device and add bus capacitance/load; it is a deviation from the documented r2 connectivity (sourcing/assembly or tampering difference).
